# Repair cafe intake on a postcard

The repair cafe postcard asks what the object does, when it failed and whether the visitor wants to watch. It does not ask for a diagnosis they cannot be expected to know. Booked six slots and left two empty for overruns. [[Repair ideas]]: waiting time should be visible before a person commits a Saturday to us.
